senses.gloss: Beth, the second letter of the Alphabeth.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 16:1:4">Y. Sabb. XVI, 15ᶜ</cite> top; a. fr.; v. <cite ref="A01935"><he>אל״ף</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 3:8:2">Y. Ned. III, 38ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>בי״ת תרי וכ׳</he> the Beth (in <he>ביצחק</he> <cite ref="Genesis 21:12">Gen. XXI, 12</cite>) intimates two, a son that is destined to inherit two worlds.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19:2">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> <he>אם אתה עושה ב׳ כ״ף</he> if thou changest the Beth into a Kaf; a. fr.—Pl. <he>בֵּיתִין</he>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 103b:3">Sabb. 103ᵇ</cite> one must not write … <he>בי׳ כפין</he> (Ms. M. <he>בָּתִּין</he>) the Beths so as to be taken for Kafs.—Chald. <cite ref="B00757"><he>בי״תא</he></cite>. Cant. R. beg.; a. fr. [<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 3:2">Shek. III, 2</cite> Mish. ed. <cite ref="B00756"><he>ביתא</he></cite>, read <cite ref="B00578"><he>בֵּיטָא</he></cite>.]
